name: iPinYou Real-Time Bidding Dataset
description: A large-scale real-time bidding click-log dataset containing ad impressions, clicks, and auction context, used for click-through-rate prediction and advertising recommendation research. This record is loader-only and does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Zhang, W., Yuan, S., & Wang, J. (2014). Optimal Real-Time Bidding for Display Advertising. Proceedings of the 20th ACM SIGKDD International Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining, 1077–1086. https://doi.org/10.1145/2623330.2623633
